title: Pedagogical bias and fairness probe
description: Short ratings used alongside interviews to capture perceived bias in retrieval (CEFR, skill, variety of English).

questions.text: Search results matched the CEFR level I asked for.
Reading resources were over-represented compared with listening/speaking.
Materials seemed biased toward Inner-Circle (UK/US) cultural topics.
I would trust this index to recommend homework for mixed-level classes.
Ask AI answers stayed within the retrieved teaching materials.
